---
title: v2.2.7 — Consolidated AI Maintainer Instructions
---

## Overview

This release moves the project's maintenance specifications into a dedicated `ai-maintainer-instructions/` directory that AI agents can discover and load on demand, adds a version bump procedure for preparing release versions and metadata, and migrates the Work test fixture guidance into the same directory. Runtime Skills, installer behavior, and release package contents are unchanged.

## Highlights

- Add root `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` entry points that direct AI agents to `ai-maintainer-instructions/` without granting extra permissions or runtime effect.
- Define a single maintenance instruction format with a restricted YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `metadata.tags`) and a fixed H2 section order.
- Migrate the Skill Bootstrap, Work and Tooling instruction architecture, release publication content, installer architecture, and Rust architecture specifications from `docs/` into the new format.
- Add a version bump procedure that derives the next `VERSION` from `main` and the used tags and releases, avoids repeated bumps on the same branch, and prepares the matching release metadata.
- Migrate the Work infrastructure fixture layout, shared material, historical evidence rules, and validation commands into `rust/work-fixtures.md`, deleting the former fixtures README.
